about_the_game:
Description and gameplay

"Real Puzzles - Paris" is a logical puzzle game in the form of puzzles. It is necessary to assemble a whole picture from its individual pieces. The game is suitable for those who are looking for a calm and relaxing pastime with family or alone.

Graphics and sound

  • The graphics in the game are detailed, bright and colorful. The overall visual design creates a pleasant and cozy atmosphere.

  • The soundtrack includes the sound effect of installing the desired puzzle in its place and background music, which together help and enhance the feeling of relaxation.

  • Each puzzle begins with its own background melody.

  • There is a volume control (mute) of the music.

 

Advantages:

  • Attractive visual style - assemble a picture from pieces.

  • Each element is made like a real puzzle - with protrusions and cutouts, into which you need to substitute the corresponding other puzzle piece.

  • 14 languages.

  • 16 levels with amazing views and sights of Paris.

  • Each image is divided into 180 elements (10х18).

  • Puzzles can be selected and assembled in any order at your discretion.

  • You can exit the current one at any time and select another puzzle.

  • To facilitate assembly, the original picture that needs to be assembled is slightly visible.

  • To change the difficulty level, you can change the visibility of the original image.

  • The puzzle elements fit into their place with a margin (stick with a magnet effect) with a simultaneous announcement that the puzzle is in the right place.

  • A correctly installed puzzle can no longer be moved.

  • To facilitate assembly, there is no need to rotate the puzzle.

  • Implemented protection against moving the puzzle beyond the edge of the screen or disappearing under the puzzles already installed in place.

  • At the end of the puzzle assembly, the time spent on assembling the current image is displayed.

  • After assembling any puzzle, the picture "comes to life" - our Know-How!

  • Relaxing gameplay.

  • The presence of 17 achievements.

 

Disadvantages:

Perhaps some shortcomings will be noticed, which, of course, will have to be corrected.

In the nearest plans:

  • Add DLC in the form of a set of used images (already implemented).

  • Add DLC in the form of a set of used music (already implemented).

  • Add collectible cards. But it depends on your activity and positive reviews. I do not insist, but I hope that you will like my game and you will tell about it.

Enough reading - time to play!

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (after 2019)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 preferred, mouse
